patch:
diff --git a/xarray/core/dataset.py b/xarray/core/dataset.py
index c775d05c..a23dee59 100644
--- a/xarray/core/dataset.py
+++ b/xarray/core/dataset.py
@@ -3773,6 +3773,12 @@ class Dataset(
             dims = tuple(dims_dict.get(dim, dim) for dim in v.dims)
             if k in result_dims:
                 var = v.to_index_variable()
+                if var is v:
+                    # to_index_variable() returns self for IndexVariable objects
+                    # (e.g. after a previous swap_dims created a dimension
+                    # coordinate). Copy before mutating .dims so that the
+                    # original variable is not modified in place.
+                    var = var.copy(deep=False)
                 var.dims = dims
                 if k in self._indexes:
                     indexes[k] = self._indexes[k]
